origin: Synthetic examples adapted from task1.3 native-config-evidence research; no upstream source file or user configuration copied.
adaptations: Grouped report examples into inert case records; added explicit expected values and unexecuted statuses. Settings sample clears the known user default instead of inventing an installed preset. Skill text/resources are synthetic, not a production navigation skill.
limitations: Source-based expectations are not observed upstream results; tests never implement or invoke applyEntryPatches, mergeLayers or native discovery.
No published tarball verification, resolved dependency tree, installation, host loading, JS evaluation or model call.
Unknown synthetic config/namespace data is not asserted valid for registered native schemas.
Exact-node JS allowlist and recursive __jsExpr rejection are proposed policy, not existing production behavior.
Repository mode checks cover executable bits; copy tests exercise shutil only, not a production deployer or private 0700/0600 deployment permissions.
Linux fixture integrity does not establish macOS or either platform's native acceptance.

tui-bundle.symbol_or_scope: disabled global loaders; dsh-tui-agent-presets; whole config JS expressions

cordis-cases.yaml.expected_behavior: Supplied config replaces the complete config; omitted name/disabled survive. Metadata-only and empty patches preserve config/rows. x-rotom-fixture is unknown DATA, not a native option.

js-cases.json.expected_behavior: Proposed exact storage-json/config/root scalar allowlist only; unsafe scalar, other tags, non-scalar JS and untagged __jsExpr carriers should reject under future rotom policy. Plain quoted expressions remain text. Policy is not executed.

settings-case.yaml.expected_behavior: Replacing agent-presets user section with {} clears its override and re-inherits composition default while retaining unregistered sibling data. This does not certify unknown keys in registered namespaces.

discovery.json.expected_behavior: Record active standard-preset scope, symbolic locations, conditional instruction order and within-scope skill ranks. Nearest scope wins before rank; project entries may shadow user skills. Paths are data only, not expanded or discovered.

rule.md.expected_behavior: Plain rule bytes retain Chinese and {{example}}/$() literals; proposed isolated-home AGENTS.md target. No template, prompt construction or native discovery executed.

skill/rotom-local-nav/SKILL.md.expected_behavior: Valid synthetic frontmatter and references to complete relative resources; not the production large-C++ navigation skill.

skill/rotom-local-nav/资料/局部说明.txt.expected_behavior: Chinese resource path and literal braces survive data-only copying.
